Log in (right top corner) with your MyDeltares-account or register first if you do not yet have an account.
Please note: if you already have a DSD- or OSS-account, but do not have a MyDeltares-account, click on the below link Forgot Password? to register your MyDeltares-account. After you have reset your password, you can login.
Click on the button <ADD TO CART> for the desired programmes.
Go to your “Shopping cart” (right top corner) to complete your registrations.
May you encounter any problems during registration, please contact our team mydeltares@deltares.nl.
